name: 55021 · Faribault, MN
findings: ZIP 55021 (Faribault) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55021 (Faribault) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55021 (Faribault) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

observations.text: 6 education organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
